metadata.title: Preliminary Summary of Distance-Exponent Readout by Independent Metric C and Relational Compensation Decomposition in an ABC Closed Phase System
metadata.description: This release publishes a preliminary summary of ABC closed phase system experiments designed to test whether adding an internal metric wave C can determine the distance exponent left open by the AB two-body experiments. The experiments introduce C-gauge validity windows, C-position controls, and decomposition of f_AB, f_AC, f_BC, and f_ABC. The results show acceleration-like AB relational compensation, but no native inverse-law or inverse-square-law dependence on position phase difference. Valid cases remained proportional-type, clarifying the boundary of the current one-dimensional localized-wave harmonic model.
metadata.notes: This paper does not deny inverse-square laws in general. It rejects only the narrower claim that the present one-dimensional AB harmonic model plus an internal C metric gauge natively produces inverse or inverse-square distance dependence.
